name: Mathu Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Newly opened resort with on-site bar and restaurant — one of the very few non-homestay dining options in Anini, India's least-densely-populated district HQ (~3,000 people). Idu Mishmi cuisine is otherwise family-cooked here, not restaurant-cooked.
insider_tip: Anini at 1,968m is genuinely remote — confirm with the resort directly before counting on a meal walk-in. For Idu Mishmi food the better option is often a homestay where the family cooks; ask your stay host about smoked pork at home rather than ordering it cold from a restaurant.
